title: utv-core (Java) deployment diagram
description: How the library runs: pom.xml builds a jar (net.icelander.utv:utv-core:0.3.0) that runs in-process in the caller's application on a Java 21 JVM, with Jackson beside it. Nothing in the folder publishes the jar to a repository; VERSIONING.md names only the git tag java/vX.Y.Z. The library opens no connection and reads no clock, host zone or locale: zone rules are data the caller loads and passes in.

nodes.name: JVM (Java 21 or later)
nodes.description: Whatever JVM runs the caller's application; pom.xml compiles for release 21.

nodes.name: Caller's application
nodes.description: The application developer's program, which calls utv-core in-process; the library starts no threads or processes of its own.

nodes.name: JDK tz database
nodes.description: The tz database bundled with the JDK, read through ZoneId.of.
nodes.condition: Only ZonedIntent.toZonedDateTime and JavaTime.toZonedDateTime use it; every other zone operation uses the caller's rules.

artifacts.name: utv-core-0.3.0.jar
artifacts.description: The library jar (packaging jar), built by mvn package from src/main/java; on the caller's class path.

artifacts.name: Zone-rule bundle (JSON)
artifacts.description: Rule data in the format of the demo bundle, read by the caller with ZoneRules.load or ZoneRules.parse. The library ships none; the demo bundle is what the tests use.

relationships.description: Runs the application with utv-core and Jackson on its class path.
In-process lookup (ZoneId.of, ZonedDateTime.ofStrict) when converting a zoned value to ZonedDateTime.
